lines: A Bill of Rights for dogs? So Rex! I'm in.
(Nina signs it, with a bone.)
{player}! Are you okay? I'm... different!
{player}: Nina?! You look... different!
So do you! My floor cracked, and we fell out of the SKY!
And where did THESE watches come from?
That yellow one with the clipboard keeps counting us. Let's say hi.
{player}! You fell too! It's me, Nina, from Maple Lane!
{player}: Nina?! You look... different!
So do you! My floor cracked, and we fell right through!
And we both got watches. Tally says we're 'chosen'!
Skies don't just break. Someone did it.
Go find Rex at the Skate Park!
You tried it! Did it wobble?
{player}: I made a bridge and a step in the air!
SO good! It works when we share it.
Try it! Make a bridge, or a step in the air!
Found Bruno yet? Try the Skate Park.
{player}! Bruno and me found out something BIG!
He wants to show you himself!
He's at the Skate Park. Go!
Bruno's bridge popped over a puddle. He got SO wet.
Morning! The lake first, then skating!
The Boutique has BUTTERFLY WINGS now!
Let's both get some!
Ooh, very heroic!
Found all the S-K-A-T-E letters?
The K is way up over the big ramp!
The sky's going gold. My favourite bit!
See you tomorrow, neighbour!
Hi again, {player}! Neighbours in both worlds!
